metadata.description: yah: project state at session start and in the statusline, plus a wrap-then-/clear loop for Claude Code.

plugins.name: yah
plugins.description: You are here: your plan, phase, next step and PRs at session start and in the statusline; nudges to wrap and /clear before limits bite; a small per-repo brain of one-fact notes; and `yah run`, which chains fresh sessions until a PR is open and green. It never merges.
